method_identity.name: PPA-RTL performance-only DPO independent adaptation
method_identity.permitted_label: independent adaptation of PPA-RTL's performance-only best-versus-worst DPO method

paper.title: Hardware Generation with High Flexibility using Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMs

matched_scope.train_split_definition: all 145 non-holdout, non-cordic designs returned by gen_sft_corpus.designs(exclude_holdout=True); the finite EDA budget selects a frozen stratified subset only from this split

prospective_label_plan.one_four_candidate_prompt_rule: highest SHA-256 rank among selected poly prompts
prospective_label_plan.candidate_composition: one catalog reference style plus four SFT samples per prompt; the declared four-candidate prompt has one reference plus three SFT samples
prospective_label_plan.no_reallocation: A slot that cannot produce an oracle-correct candidate in 16 declared attempts makes construction incomplete; do not replace the prompt, add EDA labels, or raise the cap.

performance_labeling.go_no_go: timing_closure_gate_v1/results/pilot_gate.json must be a complete PASS for manifest 2e0674f96c57be3864a6fab7683b0edc76f732762f78547d5e6a3e8efc17e194 before any candidate generation or EDA labeling
performance_labeling.training_label: the same one-implementation, 5.0 ns requested-clock WNS-derived Fmax proxy used for the existing 229-label RF budget, permitted only if the timing pilot passes
performance_labeling.budget_accounting: exactly 229 post-route implementation attempts; an implementation failure consumes its slot and receives 0 MHz; no replacement
performance_labeling.preference_score: performance-only: higher failure-aware Fmax is better; per-prompt min-max normalization is recorded but cannot change the best/worst ordering
performance_labeling.pair_rule: one maximum-score chosen and one minimum-score rejected per prompt; deterministic SHA-256 RTL-hash tie break; equal extrema yield no pair and no replacement

dpo_training.trainable_parameters: the same SFT LoRA adapter parameters; base weights frozen
dpo_training.reference: a separate frozen copy of the same SFT adapter
dpo_training.overlength_policy: fail before training; never truncate a chosen or rejected RTL silently
dpo_training.data_iteration: seeded reshuffle and cycle over the frozen preference tuples until exactly 276 optimizer updates; report repeated exposure count

true_closure_evaluation.endpoint: failure-penalized equal-sample true timing-closure Fmax from the frozen binary-search closure protocol; not single-constraint WNS extrapolation
true_closure_evaluation.reporting: each DPO seed separately, seed dispersion, pooled equal-multiplicity descriptive summary, and paired design contrasts versus SFT and repaired RF; never select the better seed

underspecified_adaptation_choices: The paper does not report DPO beta; this adaptation freezes beta=0.1.

The paper does not report optimizer, learning rate, batch size, update/epoch count, scheduler, gradient clipping, precision, sequence limits, parameter-efficient versus full tuning, checkpoints, or training seeds; matched local controls are frozen above.
The paper says five designs including generated and reference code but does not disambiguate k generated samples versus total candidates; this adaptation uses five total including one reference.
The paper does not report decoding temperature, top-p, random seeds, or prompt-sampling seed; this adaptation freezes them.
The paper states min-max normalization but does not explicitly state its scope or constant-value handling; this adaptation normalizes within each prompt and rejects equal extrema.

The paper filters unsynthesizable candidates and does not specify zero accounting; this adaptation applies the local functional oracle before EDA and retains post-route failures as zero while charging the fixed EDA budget.

The paper uses Synopsys Design Compiler with TSMC 90 nm and critical-path delay; this adaptation uses the paper's best/worst DPO logic on the local Vivado/xc7z020 domain and evaluates with true routed closure.

The paper does not publish raw PPA reports, construction code, model checkpoints, or a complete reproducible training configuration on its official project page; the released files contain chosen/rejected tuples only.
The paper's functional check is not specified during preference construction; this adaptation adds the exact local oracle gate for a controlled comparison.
The paper does not define evaluation failure denominators or seed aggregation; this adaptation retains every draw and scores all failures zero.

existing_rows_dry_run.reason: The rows have valid implementation labels and no held-out designs, but they mix known SFT/GRPO and unknown producer provenance and lack per-row frozen SFT generation seeds plus the two-seed oracle gate. They may audit the matched label count but may not be converted into DPO tuples.
